problem_text:
A municipality aims to devise a strategy for curbing nutrient runoff into a local watershed from several agricultural plots. Initially, no mitigation practices are in place.

The characteristics of each plot are as follows:
* For Field 1, the runoff coefficient is 2.013, and the cultivated area is 149.509.
* For Field 2, the runoff coefficient is 2.198, and the cultivated area is 212.39.
* For Field 3, the runoff coefficient is 2.872, and the cultivated area is 112.403.
* For Field 4, the runoff coefficient is 1.43, and the cultivated area is 78.362.
* For Field 5, the runoff coefficient is 2.408, and the cultivated area is 233.919.
* For Field 6, the runoff coefficient is 1.935, and the cultivated area is 174.761.
* For Field 7, the runoff coefficient is 1.824, and the cultivated area is 146.747.

To mitigate nutrient loss, several best management practices (BMPs) are available, each characterized by a specific reduction efficacy:
* By implementing Practice1, nutrient export will be reduced by 45%
* By implementing Practice2, nutrient export will be reduced by 69%
* By implementing Practice3, nutrient export will be reduced by 69%
* By implementing Practice4, nutrient export will be reduced by 54%
* By implementing Practice5, nutrient export will be reduced by 10%
* By implementing Practice6, nutrient export will be reduced by 67%
* By implementing Practice7, nutrient export will be reduced by 17%

Adopting a BMP on a plot incurs an additional implementation cost per unit area. The cost matrix for all plot–practice combinations is summarized below:

| Plot \ Practice | Practice1 | Practice2 | Practice3 | Practice4 | Practice5 | Practice6 | Practice7 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field 1 | 103.328 | 33.301 | 172.037 | 95.888 | 180.749 | 94.571 | 26.68 |
| Field 2 | 139.567 | 170.649 | 70.722 | 76.011 | 22.338 | 113.013 | 179.353 |
| Field 3 | 171.759 | 145.244 | 186.192 | 131.163 | 160.802 | 106.664 | 33.059 |
| Field 4 | 48.186 | 36.387 | 160.171 | 14.994 | 115.264 | 80.093 | 162.696 |
| Field 5 | 114.813 | 126.27 | 26.381 | 68.765 | 199.923 | 146.585 | 109.882 |
| Field 6 | 156.141 | 166.434 | 24.013 | 194.752 | 132.044 | 95.495 | 139.221 |
| Field 7 | 75.458 | 176.812 | 158.25 | 131.561 | 44.573 | 193.59 | 92.197 |

The planning authority must decide which BMPs to apply to each plot (plots may adopt multiple practices concurrently), and it is permissible for a plot to remain partially untreated if needed. The objective is to ensure that the total nutrient load is reduced by at least a proportion P = 0.655 of the baseline load, while minimizing the total implementation expenditure.
